summary: cisco.iosxr deprecates automatic Jinja2 templating of iosxr_config's src parameter (removed March 2028); use content with the template lookup.

answer_card.title: iosxr_config src templating deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: In `cisco.iosxr.iosxr_config`, automatic Jinja2 processing of `src` is deprecated and removed in **March 2028**. Use `content` with the `ansible.builtin.template` lookup.
